<noinclude>{{SbcHeaderLojbanPod|title=Room Service|id=A0106}}</noinclude>
{{SbcIntroductionLojbanPod}}
This is the lesson for all the fans of room service! And the room service might be even better when you order in Lojban! The rest of us will learn how to order a hamburger, which can be pretty useful, too. The keyword is: '''servicio a la habitación''' – room service.
{{SbcSourceLojbanPod|[[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0003|A0003: At the bar]], [[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0052|A0052: Smells good]], [[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0096|A0096: I am allergic]]}}

{{SbcExercisesLojbanPod}}
<noinclude>====Dialogue Translation====
Translate from Lojban to English. Click each bar to check your answer. If possible, read the Lojban sentences aloud.
{{SbcQuestion
| '''¿Tiene servicio a la habitación?'''
| Do you have room service?
| '''Sí tenemos.'''
| We do have it.
| '''Quiero una hamburguesa.'''
| I want a hamburger.
| '''Se la llevo en diez minutos.'''
| I bring it to you in 10 minutes.
| '''Gracias.'''
| Thank you.
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Translation====
Cover the right column, translate from Lojban to English and uncover the right column line by line to check your answers. If possible, read the Lojban sentences aloud.
{{SbcQuestionPrint
| '''¿Tiene servicio a la habitación?'''
| Do you have room service?
| '''Sí tenemos.'''
| We do have it.
| '''Quiero una hamburguesa.'''
| I want a hamburger.
| '''Se la llevo en diez minutos.'''
| I bring it to you in 10 minutes.
| '''Gracias.'''
| Thank you.
}}</includeonly>

<noinclude>====Dialogue Remix====
Translate this variant of the dialogue from English to Lojban.
{{SbcQuestion
| Do you have room service?
| '''¿Tiene servicio a la habitación?'''
| We do have it.
| '''Sí tenemos.'''
| I want a hamburger.
| '''Quiero una hamburguesa.'''
| We don't have hamburgers.
| '''No tenemos hamburguesas.'''
| Do you have jalapeños?
| '''¿Tiene jalapeños?'''
| No, we don't have jalapeños.
| '''No, no tenemos jalapeños.'''
| Tacos?
| '''¿Tacos?
| No, we don't have tacos.
| '''No, no tenemos tacos.'''
| I want room service!
| '''¡Quiero servicio a la habitación!'''
| I bring it to you in 10 minutes. Thank you.
| '''Se lo llevo en diez minutos. Gracias.'''
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Remix====
Translate this variant of the dialogue from English to Lojban.
{{SbcQuestionPrint
| Do you have room service?
| '''¿Tiene servicio a la habitación?'''
| We do have it.
| '''Sí tenemos.'''
| I want a hamburger.
| '''Quiero una hamburguesa.'''
| We don't have hamburgers.
| '''No tenemos hamburguesas.'''
| Do you have jalapeños?
| '''¿Tiene jalapeños?'''
| No, we don't have jalapeños.
| '''No, no tenemos jalapeños.'''
| Tacos?
| '''¿Tacos?
| No, we don't have tacos.
| '''No, no tenemos tacos.'''
| I want room service!
| '''¡Quiero servicio a la habitación!'''
| I bring it to you in 10 minutes. Thank you.
| '''Se lo llevo en diez minutos. Gracias.'''
}}</includeonly>

| '''Se la llevo en diez minutos.'''
| Thank you.
